metadata.method: LLM Agent · enriquecimiento bilingüe + acronyms processing
metadata.universe_canon: banana cold chain · Puerto Antioquia · MV CARIBBEAN STAR · cast 9

entries.english_definition: Specific quantifier with measurement unit indicating cargo load per refrigerated container.
entries.example_in_context: Yurlenis Palacios, the tally clerk, confirms: we are loading 27 tonnes per reefer container in bay 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: 27 toneladas por reefer · cuantificador específico con unidad de medida (tonelada métrica) usado en planes de estiba de carga banana.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding a recommendation given over VHF radio.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas, the port pilot, transmits: Advice. Reduce speed to five knots before approaching berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Aviso/Recomendación · marcador SMCP que antecede una recomendación. En español SMCP se traduce como 'Aviso' (no como 'consejo').

entries.english_definition: SMCP standard response meaning 'yes' in maritime VHF communication.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming responds over VHF: Affirmative. Berth three is available for the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Afirmativo · respuesta estándar SMCP equivalente a 'sí'. Anglicismo aceptado en español técnico marítimo.

entries.english_definition: Automatic Identification System · transponder that broadcasts vessel position, course and speed for collision avoidance and traffic monitoring.
entries.example_in_context: Puerto Antioquia VTS tracks the MV CARIBBEAN STAR via AIS as it approaches at two nautical miles.
entries.equivalente_espanol: AIS · Sistema de Identificación Automática. Sigla inglesa de uso universal en español técnico marítimo (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: Safety warning device that emits an audible or visual signal when a hazardous condition is detected (e.g., temperature deviation, fire, intrusion).
entries.example_in_context: The temperature alarm is on. Pipa, the refrigeration technician, immediately checks reefer container 14 on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Alarma · dispositivo de aviso de seguridad. En contexto reefer también se acepta 'alarma de temperatura' o 'alarma de cadena de frío'.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: NAVIGATIONAL AND SAFETY-RELATED EQUIPMENT OF THE SHIP

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding a response to a question over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming replies: Answer. Berth depth twelve meters at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Respuesta · marcador SMCP que precede la contestación a una Question previa. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: Agreement on the International Carriage of Perishable Foodstuffs · UN treaty regulating temperature-controlled transport of perishables (banana cold chain).
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR carries an ATP certificate guaranteeing setpoint compliance at 13.3°C from Urabá to Hamburg.
entries.equivalente_espanol: ATP · Acuerdo sobre el Transporte Internacional de Productos Alimenticios Perecederos. Sigla francesa de uso oficial en español (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: Bill of Lading · legal shipping document issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo and serving as title of goods.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo signs the B/L for 27 tonnes per reefer of Cavendish banana before the MV CARIBBEAN STAR departs Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: B/L · Conocimiento de Embarque (sigla inglesa estándar usada en comercio exterior colombiano). También 'BL' o 'B.L.'.

entries.english_definition: Designated docking position at a pier where a vessel moors for cargo operations.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR is assigned berth three at Puerto Antioquia for banana loading.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Muelle de atraque · puesto/posición de atraque. En español portuario se usa también 'atracadero' o 'sitio de atraque'.

entries.english_definition: Specific docking position number three at the terminal, assigned by port authority.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR is mooring at berth three under Carolina Vargas's pilot guidance.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Muelle tres · posición de atraque número tres. Se mantiene el numeral en inglés en comunicaciones SMCP.

entries.english_definition: Boatswain · senior deck crew member who supervises sailors and deck operations such as mooring.
entries.example_in_context: Andrés Mejía, the bosun on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR, instructs the deck crew to make fast on bow line one.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Contramaestre · supervisor de cubierta. 'Bosun' es la forma coloquial de 'boatswain' usada en SMCP.

entries.english_definition: Front part of a ship.
entries.example_in_context: The bow of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR is approaching berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Proa · parte delantera del buque. Término marítimo estándar en español.

entries.english_definition: Mooring rope attached at the bow of a vessel to secure it to the pier.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming orders Andrés Mejía: Make fast on bow line one at berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Estacha de proa · cabo/línea de amarre en la proa. También 'línea de proa' en español portuario.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: Command center of a ship, where the captain and officers navigate and control operations.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming is on the bridge of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR coordinating with port pilot Carolina Vargas via VHF.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Puente de mando · cabina de gobierno del buque. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Bulk cargo vessel designed to carry unpackaged dry cargo (grain, coal, ore) in large holds.
entries.example_in_context: Those vessels at Puerto Antioquia are bulkers; the MV CARIBBEAN STAR is a reefer ship for banana cargo.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Granelero · buque de carga a granel. Anglicismo 'bulker' aceptado en jerga portuaria colombiana.

entries.english_definition: Unique vessel identifier spelled in NATO Phonetic Alphabet for VHF radio communication.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas requests: Spell the call sign please. Captain Lim replies: Charlie Sierra Tango Alpha Romeo.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Distintivo de llamada · identificador único del buque para radiocomunicación. Se mantiene anglicismo en español técnico.

entries.english_definition: Modal verb expressing permission or possibility.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo tells Manuel Padilla: You can request a phytosanitary inspection from ICA before loading.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Poder (puedo/puedes) · verbo modal de permiso o posibilidad. Modal básico A1-A2.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: MODAL VERBS: CAN, COULD, SHOULD, MUST FOR REQUEST, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY, PERMISSION

entries.english_definition: Compartment inside a vessel for storing cargo.
entries.example_in_context: There are six cargo holds on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR, all refrigerated for Cavendish banana export.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Bodega de carga · compartimento de almacenamiento. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Standard export variety of banana grown in Urabá and shipped to European markets.
entries.example_in_context: Puerto Antioquia ships Cavendish banana to Hamburg under setpoint 13.3°C on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Cavendish · variedad estándar de banano de exportación. Nombre propio que no se traduce.

entries.english_definition: VHF radio channels used in maritime communication: channel 16 for distress and calling, channel 12 for working/port traffic.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas instructs the MV CARIBBEAN STAR: Switch to channel twelve for berthing coordination at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Canal dieciséis/doce · canales VHF (16 emergencia, 12 trabajo portuario). Se mantienen los numerales en inglés en SMCP.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: UNIT 5: INTRODUCING IMO STANDARD MARINE COMMUNICATION PHRASES (SMCP)

entries.english_definition: End-to-end temperature-controlled supply chain that preserves perishable cargo (banana) from harvest to retail.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo monitors the cold chain from Urabá farm to Hamburg, keeping setpoint 13.3°C across the MV CARIBBEAN STAR voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Cadena de frío · sistema integrado de control de temperatura. Término técnico estándar en español.

entries.english_definition: Professional responsible for the integrity of the temperature-controlled supply chain.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo is the cold chain coordinator at Puerto Antioquia and supervises Manuel Padilla on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR loading.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Coordinador/a de cadena de frío · profesional responsable de la integridad térmica end-to-end.

entries.english_definition: Convention on the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea · IMO rules of navigation and right-of-way.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming applies COLREG rules when crossing traffic near Puerto Antioquia approach lanes.
entries.equivalente_espanol: COLREG · Reglamento Internacional para Prevenir Abordajes (RIPA en español oficial). Sigla inglesa de uso técnico universal.

entries.english_definition: Vessel designed to carry standardized intermodal containers (TEU/FEU).
entries.example_in_context: That is a container ship; the MV CARIBBEAN STAR is a specialized reefer ship for banana cargo.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Buque portacontenedores · embarcación para contenedores estandarizados. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Process of packing cargo into standardized intermodal containers for shipment.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo is supervising the containerization of 27 tonnes per reefer of Cavendish banana on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Contenedorización · proceso de empacar carga en contenedores estándar. Anglicismo aceptado en español logístico.

entries.english_definition: Modal verb expressing polite suggestion or past possibility.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa suggests to Manuel Padilla: We could re-plug starboard reefers if the genset goes offline.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Podría/Podríamos · modal de sugerencia cortés o posibilidad. Forma condicional/pasada de 'can'.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: MODAL VERBS: CAN, COULD, SHOULD, MUST FOR REQUEST, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY, PERMISSION

entries.english_definition: Port facility with deep draft capable of receiving large vessels such as banana reefer ships.
entries.example_in_context: Puerto Antioquia is a deep-water terminal able to receive the MV CARIBBEAN STAR fully loaded with Cavendish banana.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Terminal de aguas profundas · puerto con calado suficiente para buques de gran porte.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: UNIT 3: PLACES IN PORT AND POSITION

entries.english_definition: Sequence of operations executed when a vessel leaves the berth and exits port waters.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming announces: We will start the departure procedure once Yurlenis confirms the final tally on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Procedimiento de zarpe · secuencia operativa de salida del buque del puerto.

entries.english_definition: Negative imperative used in safety-critical instructions.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos warns the crew: Do not break the cold chain · keep setpoint 13.3°C across the MV CARIBBEAN STAR voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: No rompa/No interrumpa · imperativo negativo. Forma de instrucción de seguridad.

entries.english_definition: Coordinated operation of bringing a vessel alongside a berth.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas, the port pilot, is coordinating the docking maneuver of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR at berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Maniobra de atraque · operación de aproximación y atraque del buque al muelle.

entries.english_definition: Electronic Data Interchange · standardized digital exchange of shipping documents (B/L, manifest, customs).
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo transmits the cargo manifest of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR via EDI to Hamburg port authority.
entries.equivalente_espanol: EDI · Intercambio Electrónico de Datos. Sigla inglesa estándar en comercio exterior.

entries.english_definition: Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacon · device that transmits a distress signal with vessel position via satellite.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR's EPIRB activates automatically if the vessel sinks during the Urabá-Hamburg voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: EPIRB · Radiobaliza de Localización de Siniestros. Sigla inglesa de uso universal en español técnico marítimo.

entries.english_definition: Estimated Time of Arrival · forecast time when a vessel will reach a port or position.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming reports: ETA Puerto Antioquia is 0600 local time for the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: ETA · Hora Estimada de Llegada. Sigla inglesa de uso universal en español técnico marítimo y logístico.

entries.english_definition: Estimated Time of Departure · forecast time when a vessel will leave a port.
entries.example_in_context: ETD of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR from Puerto Antioquia is 1800 local, bound for Hamburg.
entries.equivalente_espanol: ETD · Hora Estimada de Zarpe/Salida. Sigla inglesa estándar en logística portuaria.

entries.english_definition: Forty-foot Equivalent Unit · standard 40-foot intermodal container size used in shipping capacity measurement.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR loads 200 FEU of Cavendish reefer containers at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: FEU · Unidad Equivalente a Cuarenta pies. Sigla inglesa estándar en logística (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: Specific numeric quantifier for banana clusters loaded in a bay.
entries.example_in_context: Yurlenis Palacios, the tally clerk, counts forty-seven clusters in bay 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Cuarenta y siete racimos · cuantificador numérico específico de racimos de banano.

entries.english_definition: Generator set · backup electrical power unit attached to a reefer container when shore power is unavailable.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa connects the genset to reefer container 14 on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR during shore-power transition.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Genset · grupo electrógeno. Anglicismo aceptado en jerga reefer (también 'planta eléctrica auxiliar').

entries.english_definition: International Good Agricultural Practices certification mark on cargo packaging guaranteeing farm-level quality standards.
entries.example_in_context: The Cavendish clusters loaded onto the MV CARIBBEAN STAR carry the GlobalGAP seal verified by Mariana Restrepo.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Sello GlobalGAP · certificación internacional de Buenas Prácticas Agrícolas. Nombre propio que no se traduce.

entries.english_definition: Global Maritime Distress and Safety System · IMO satellite-based radio system for distress alerting and search-and-rescue coordination.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR's GMDSS station is monitored 24/7 by Captain Lim Wei-Ming during the Urabá-Hamburg voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: GMDSS · Sistema Mundial de Socorro y Seguridad Marítimos (SMSSM en español oficial OMI, pero la sigla GMDSS es de uso universal).

entries.english_definition: Global Positioning System · satellite-based navigation providing precise vessel position and time.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming verifies the MV CARIBBEAN STAR's position via GPS as the vessel approaches Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: GPS · Sistema de Posicionamiento Global. Sigla inglesa de uso universal en español (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: Hazardous Materials · cargo that poses risk to health, safety or environment and requires special handling under IMDG code.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos verifies that no HAZMAT containers are stowed adjacent to the Cavendish reefers on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: HAZMAT · Mercancías Peligrosas / Materiales Peligrosos. Sigla inglesa de uso universal en logística internacional.

entries.english_definition: Crew member at the wheel responsible for steering the vessel.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming orders: Helmsman, steady · maintaining course towards berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Timonel · marino al timón. Término marítimo estándar en español.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: Imperative command to lift a container or cargo with a crane.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo instructs the crane operator: Hoist container twenty-three to bay 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Izar/Levantar · imperativo dirigido al gruero. Comando portuario estándar.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: Present simple Wh-question pattern asking about the functioning of a process or device.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla asks Pipa: How does the reefer plug work on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR?
entries.equivalente_espanol: ¿Cómo funciona X? · estructura de pregunta Wh- en presente simple. Patrón A2 estándar.

entries.english_definition: Main watertight body of a ship.
entries.example_in_context: The hull of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR is painted white with the Star Reefers logo at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Casco · cuerpo principal estanco del buque. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Amount of moisture in the air, expressed as a percentage; critical parameter for banana cold chain.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa logs: The humidity inside reefer 14 is 75 percent · within Cavendish banana setpoint range.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Humedad · cantidad de vapor de agua en el aire (%). Parámetro crítico de cadena de frío.

entries.english_definition: International Air Transport Association · global airline trade body that sets standards for air cargo (relevant for air-sea perishables).
entries.example_in_context: Some perishables follow IATA standards by air; the Cavendish banana on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR follows IMO/ATP standards by sea.
entries.equivalente_espanol: IATA · Asociación de Transporte Aéreo Internacional. Sigla inglesa de uso universal.

entries.english_definition: Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario · Colombian agricultural authority that issues phytosanitary certificates for export cargo.
entries.example_in_context: ICA inspectors at Puerto Antioquia verify Cavendish banana before loading 27 tonnes per reefer onto the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: ICA · Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario. Sigla en español, nombre propio (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: Phytosanitary certificate issued by ICA verifying the health of plant cargo for export.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo presents the ICA phytosanitary certificate to Captain Lim Wei-Ming before the MV CARIBBEAN STAR loads Cavendish banana.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Certificado fitosanitario ICA · documento sanitario obligatorio para exportación de banano colombiano.

entries.english_definition: International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code · IMO regulations for safe transport of hazardous materials by sea.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos confirms no IMDG-classified cargo is stowed near the Cavendish reefers on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: IMDG · Código Marítimo Internacional de Mercancías Peligrosas. Sigla inglesa de uso universal en español técnico.

entries.english_definition: International Maritime Organization · UN agency that regulates international shipping safety, security and environmental performance.
entries.example_in_context: The SMCP used between Captain Lim Wei-Ming and Carolina Vargas at Puerto Antioquia is an IMO standard.
entries.equivalente_espanol: IMO · Organización Marítima Internacional. Equivale a OMI en español oficial; ambas siglas se usan.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding factual data shared over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas transmits: Information. Vessel approaching berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Información · marcador SMCP que precede datos compartidos. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding an order or directive.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas radios the MV CARIBBEAN STAR: Instruction. Switch to channel twelve.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Instrucción · marcador SMCP que precede una orden. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding a stated plan or intended action.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming announces: Intention. Anchoring at position alpha outside Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Intención · marcador SMCP que precede un plan declarado. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: International Organization for Standardization · sets dimensional standards for intermodal containers (ISO 668) and quality management.
entries.example_in_context: The reefer containers loaded on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR comply with ISO 668 dimensions.
entries.equivalente_espanol: ISO · Organización Internacional de Normalización. Sigla universal (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: International Ship and Port Facility Security Code · IMO security regime for vessels and port facilities post-2002.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos enforces ISPS access control at Puerto Antioquia gate before the MV CARIBBEAN STAR berths.
entries.equivalente_espanol: ISPS · Código Internacional para la Protección de los Buques e Instalaciones Portuarias (Código PBIP en español). Sigla inglesa de uso universal.

entries.english_definition: SMCP imperative command to secure a mooring line.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming orders: Bosun, make fast on bow line one at berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Amarrar/Asegurar · imperativo SMCP para fijar una estacha. Comando de cubierta estándar.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: Indefinite quantifier expressing a large quantity of countable items.
entries.example_in_context: Many containers leave Puerto Antioquia every week aboard reefer ships such as the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Muchos contenedores · cuantificador indefinido grande para sustantivos contables.

entries.english_definition: International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships · IMO treaty regulating marine pollution from oil, chemicals, garbage and emissions.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR follows MARPOL Annex V for garbage management on its Urabá-Hamburg voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: MARPOL · Convenio Internacional para Prevenir la Contaminación por los Buques. Sigla inglesa de uso universal.

entries.english_definition: Verbal label preceding an SMCP message that classifies its purpose (Information, Instruction, Question, Answer, Request, Advice, Warning, Intention).
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas always opens with a message marker: Information. Vessel approaching berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Marcador de mensaje · etiqueta verbal SMCP que clasifica el propósito comunicativo. Concepto pedagógico clave SMCP.

entries.english_definition: Process of securing a vessel to a berth using ropes (lines).
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR is mooring at berth three under bosun Andrés Mejía's coordination.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Amarre · proceso de fijación del buque al muelle mediante estachas. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Material Safety Data Sheet · document with chemical safety information for hazardous substances on board.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa keeps the MSDS of the reefer refrigerant accessible on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR engine room.
entries.equivalente_espanol: MSDS · Hoja de Datos de Seguridad del Material (HDS en español). Sigla inglesa común en industria.

entries.english_definition: Modal verb expressing strong obligation or necessity.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos states: Crew must wear PPE in the reefer yard at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Debe/Tiene que · modal de obligación fuerte. Forma básica A2.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: MODAL VERBS: CAN, COULD, SHOULD, MUST FOR REQUEST, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY, PERMISSION

entries.english_definition: Designated assembly point on a vessel or terminal where personnel gather during emergencies.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos shows Manuel Padilla the muster station on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR during the safety drill.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Punto de encuentro / Punto de reunión de emergencia · zona de seguridad para evacuación.

entries.english_definition: North Atlantic Treaty Organization · author of the phonetic alphabet adopted by IMO/SMCP for spelling words over VHF radio.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla learns the NATO Phonetic Alphabet to spell the call sign of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR over VHF.
entries.equivalente_espanol: NATO/OTAN · Organización del Tratado del Atlántico Norte. En contexto SMCP se mantiene 'NATO Phonetic Alphabet' sin traducir.

entries.english_definition: Standardized spelling alphabet (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta...) adopted by IMO for clear VHF communication.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming spells: I spell. Charlie Sierra Tango Alpha Romeo · the call sign of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Alfabeto Fonético OTAN · sistema estándar de deletreo radiotelefónico. Anclaje SMCP obligatorio.

entries.english_definition: SMCP standard response meaning 'no' over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas replies: Negative. Channel sixteen is busy · switch to channel twelve.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Negativo · respuesta estándar SMCP equivalente a 'no'. Anglicismo aceptado en español técnico marítimo.

entries.english_definition: Organización Marítima Internacional · Spanish-language equivalent of IMO; UN agency for maritime regulation.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla studies SMCP, an OMI standard, to communicate with Captain Lim Wei-Ming on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: OMI · Organización Marítima Internacional. Equivalente español oficial de IMO; ambas siglas conviven.

entries.english_definition: Process of preparing and protecting cargo (banana clusters) for shipment.
entries.example_in_context: At Puerto Antioquia, the Cavendish clusters are being packed in plastic film before loading onto the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Empaque · proceso de preparación y protección de la carga para transporte.

entries.english_definition: Plant health verification of cargo performed by ICA before export.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo says: You can request a phytosanitary inspection from ICA before loading the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Inspección fitosanitaria · revisión sanitaria vegetal de la carga. Trámite ICA obligatorio para exportación.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: MODAL VERBS: CAN, COULD, SHOULD, MUST FOR REQUEST, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY, PERMISSION

entries.english_definition: Structure extending into water along which vessels dock for cargo operations.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming reports: The pier is at five hundred meters · approaching berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Muelle · estructura portuaria de atraque. Sinónimo de 'wharf' en algunos contextos.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: UNIT 3: PLACES IN PORT AND POSITION

entries.english_definition: Port pilot · licensed expert who boards and guides vessels through restricted port waters.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas, the pilot, boards the MV CARIBBEAN STAR two nautical miles from Puerto Antioquia to guide the docking maneuver.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Práctico (de puerto) · piloto portuario que guía buques al atraque. NO confundir con 'pilot' aviación.

entries.english_definition: Protective polyethylene wrap applied to banana clusters during packing.
entries.example_in_context: At Puerto Antioquia, the Cavendish clusters are packed in plastic film before being stowed in reefer 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Film plástico · envoltura protectora de polietileno. También 'plástico de empaque' o 'lámina plástica'.

entries.english_definition: Imperative phrasal verb meaning to connect the reefer container to the power supply.
entries.example_in_context: Mariana Restrepo orders: Plug in the reefer · keep setpoint 13.3°C on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Conecte/Enchufe · imperativo phrasal verb. Comando reefer estándar.

entries.english_definition: Port of Discharge · destination port where cargo is unloaded from the vessel.
entries.example_in_context: The B/L of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR shows POD: Hamburg for the Cavendish banana shipment.
entries.equivalente_espanol: POD · Puerto de Descarga. Sigla inglesa estándar en logística marítima.

entries.english_definition: Port of Loading · origin port where cargo is loaded onto the vessel.
entries.example_in_context: The B/L shows POL: Puerto Antioquia, POD: Hamburg for the MV CARIBBEAN STAR voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: POL · Puerto de Carga/Embarque. Sigla inglesa estándar en logística marítima.

entries.english_definition: SMCP helm command to alter course ten or five degrees to port (left).
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas relays: Helmsman, port ten · easing the MV CARIBBEAN STAR towards berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Babor diez / babor cinco · comando de timón SMCP (giro a la izquierda en grados).

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: Personal Protective Equipment · safety gear (helmet, gloves, boots, vest) required at port and on board.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos enforces: Wear PPE in the reefer yard before approaching the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: EPP · Equipo de Protección Personal (en español SST se usa EPP/EPI). Sigla inglesa también común en jerga industrial.

entries.english_definition: Refrigerated facility at the port where banana cargo is brought to setpoint temperature before loading.
entries.example_in_context: The pre-cooling chamber at Puerto Antioquia is operational at 13.3°C before the Cavendish clusters move to the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Cámara de pre-enfriamiento · instalación de pre-enfriado de carga banana antes del embarque.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding an inquiry over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming asks: Question. Berth depth in meters at Puerto Antioquia?
entries.equivalente_espanol: Pregunta · marcador SMCP que precede una consulta. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: Resultado de Aprendizaje 1 · first learning outcome of the IMARPOR program (vessel parts, equipment, professions on board).
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla completes RA1 at Puerto Antioquia by identifying parts of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR with bosun Andrés Mejía.
entries.equivalente_espanol: RA1 · Resultado de Aprendizaje 1. Sigla SENA pedagógica.

entries.english_definition: Resultado de Aprendizaje 2 · second learning outcome focused on SMCP and VHF communication.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla practices RA2 by simulating VHF dialogues with Captain Lim Wei-Ming aboard the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: RA2 · Resultado de Aprendizaje 2. Sigla SENA pedagógica.

entries.english_definition: Resultado de Aprendizaje 3 · third learning outcome on commands, modals and imperatives in port operations.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla applies RA3 by giving safety imperatives in the reefer yard supervised by Hernando Ríos.
entries.equivalente_espanol: RA3 · Resultado de Aprendizaje 3. Sigla SENA pedagógica.

entries.english_definition: Resultado de Aprendizaje 4 · fourth learning outcome on docking, departure, packing and cold chain documentation.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla closes RA4 by issuing the B/L for the MV CARIBBEAN STAR's Cavendish cargo bound for Hamburg.
entries.equivalente_espanol: RA4 · Resultado de Aprendizaje 4. Sigla SENA pedagógica.

entries.english_definition: Refrigerated intermodal container used to transport temperature-sensitive cargo such as Cavendish banana.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa inspects reefer container 14 at setpoint 13.3°C before loading onto the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Contenedor refrigerado · 'reefer' es anglicismo aceptado en jerga portuaria colombiana.

entries.english_definition: Electrical socket/plug used to power a refrigerated container from shore power or genset.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa connects the reefer plug to the shore power outlet at berth three before the MV CARIBBEAN STAR cargo operations begin.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Enchufe reefer · conexión eléctrica del contenedor refrigerado. Anglicismo técnico.

entries.english_definition: Refrigerated cargo vessel specialized in cold-chain shipments such as banana export.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR is a reefer ship of the Star Reefers fleet, designed for Cavendish banana export from Urabá.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Buque refrigerado / buque reefer · embarcación especializada cadena de frío. Anglicismo aceptado.

entries.english_definition: Designated terminal area where reefer containers are stacked and connected to power awaiting loading or after discharge.
entries.example_in_context: At Puerto Antioquia, the reefer yard is between the pier and the pre-cooling chamber, with 200 plug-in slots.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Patio reefer · zona de acopio de contenedores refrigerados con tomas eléctricas.

entries.english_definition: Reefer maintenance professional in charge of monitoring and repairing refrigeration units.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa is the refrigeration technician on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR and ensures all reefers stay at setpoint 13.3°C.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Técnico/a de refrigeración · profesional de mantenimiento reefer. También 'técnico reefer'.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding a request for action over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming asks Carolina Vargas: Request. Tug assistance for berthing the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Solicitud · marcador SMCP que precede una petición de acción. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: Radio Frequency Identification · electronic tag technology used to track containers and cargo automatically.
entries.example_in_context: Yurlenis Palacios scans the RFID tag of each reefer entering bay 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: RFID · Identificación por Radiofrecuencia. Sigla inglesa de uso universal (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: SMCP standard response meaning 'message received and understood'.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming replies: Roger. Standby for pilot boarding · MV CARIBBEAN STAR ready.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Roger · 'mensaje recibido y entendido' (SMCP). Anglicismo intraducible en VHF marítima.

entries.english_definition: Terminal officer responsible for occupational safety and emergency response.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos is the safety manager at Puerto Antioquia and coordinates PPE compliance during the MV CARIBBEAN STAR operations.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Gerente / Jefe de seguridad · responsable SST de la terminal portuaria.

entries.english_definition: SMCP request to repeat the last transmitted message.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla over VHF: Say again. Last word · acknowledging an unclear instruction from Carolina Vargas.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Repita · solicitud SMCP de repetición. Frase estándar (NO usar 'repeat' que tiene otro significado en SMCP).

entries.english_definition: Device that measures temperature, humidity or other physical parameters in reefer containers.
entries.example_in_context: These sensors are calibrated · Pipa verifies setpoint 13.3°C in reefer 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Sensor · dispositivo de medición. Término técnico estándar en español.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: NAVIGATIONAL AND SAFETY-RELATED EQUIPMENT OF THE SHIP

entries.english_definition: Target temperature for a reefer container; for Cavendish banana the standard range is 13.3-13.9°C.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa checks the setpoint at 13.3°C on every reefer of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR before departure from Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Setpoint · temperatura objetivo. Anglicismo aceptado en cadena de frío (también 'consigna de temperatura').

entries.english_definition: Indefinite quantifier expressing 'some/a few' (more than two but not many).
entries.example_in_context: Yurlenis Palacios reports: There are several pallets in bay 15 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR pending tally.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Varios pallets · cuantificador indefinido medio. 'Pallet' anglicismo aceptado.

entries.english_definition: Merchant vessel.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR is a reefer ship operating the Urabá-Hamburg banana route.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Buque / Barco · embarcación mercante. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Vessel's own electrical power source (typically a genset) used as backup when shore power is unavailable.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa announces: We will switch to ship power on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR during the shore-power transition at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Energía/Corriente del buque · alimentación eléctrica propia del barco (planta eléctrica auxiliar).

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: MODAL VERBS: CAN, COULD, SHOULD, MUST FOR REQUEST, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY, PERMISSION

entries.english_definition: Modal verb expressing recommendation or mild advice.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa advises Manuel Padilla: You should check the setpoint of reefer 14 every hour on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Debería · modal de recomendación o consejo. Forma A2 estándar.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: MODAL VERBS: CAN, COULD, SHOULD, MUST FOR REQUEST, PROHIBITION, POSSIBILITY, PERMISSION

entries.english_definition: Standard Marine Communication Phrases · IMO standardized phraseology for safe and unambiguous VHF communication at sea.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla studies SMCP to communicate with Captain Lim Wei-Ming and port pilot Carolina Vargas during MV CARIBBEAN STAR operations.
entries.equivalente_espanol: SMCP · Frases Normalizadas de Comunicación Marítima (FNCM en español oficial OMI), pero la sigla SMCP es de uso universal.

entries.english_definition: International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea · IMO treaty setting minimum safety standards for ships.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR complies with SOLAS Chapter III lifesaving appliances during the Urabá-Hamburg voyage.
entries.equivalente_espanol: SOLAS · Convenio Internacional para la Seguridad de la Vida Humana en el Mar. Sigla inglesa de uso universal.

entries.english_definition: SMCP request to spell a word using NATO Phonetic Alphabet for clarity over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas asks: Spell that. Captain Lim Wei-Ming responds: Charlie Sierra Tango · the MV CARIBBEAN STAR call sign.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Deletree · imperativo SMCP de deletreo fonético. Frase estándar VHF.

entries.english_definition: Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo · Colombian occupational health and safety regulatory framework.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos implements SST protocols at Puerto Antioquia before the MV CARIBBEAN STAR berths.
entries.equivalente_espanol: SST · Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo. Sigla en español, marco normativo colombiano (Decreto 1072 de 2015).

entries.english_definition: Imperative safety command instructing personnel to move away from a hazard.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa shouts: Stand clear of the genset on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR · live electrical equipment.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Aléjese / Manténgase alejado · imperativo de seguridad. Comando estándar SST.

entries.english_definition: SMCP standard response meaning 'wait' or 'hold position'.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas radios: Standby for pilot boarding · MV CARIBBEAN STAR maintain heading.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Standby · 'a la espera/aguarde' (SMCP). Anglicismo aceptado en VHF marítima.

entries.english_definition: Right side of a vessel when facing the bow.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa suggests: We could re-plug starboard reefers on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR if portside genset fails.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Estribor · costado derecho del buque mirando hacia proa. Término marítimo estándar.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers · IMO crew training standards.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming and the MV CARIBBEAN STAR crew hold STCW certificates required for international voyages.
entries.equivalente_espanol: STCW · Convenio Internacional sobre Normas de Formación, Titulación y Guardia para la Gente de Mar. Sigla inglesa universal.

entries.english_definition: SMCP helm command to maintain current heading.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming orders: Helmsman, steady · MV CARIBBEAN STAR maintaining course to berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Mantenga rumbo · comando SMCP de timón. Frase estándar de gobierno.

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: COMMANDS (TO: OFFICERS, SAILORS, HELMSMAN, CAPTAINS, ENGINEERS, STEWARD, CRANE OPERATORS)

entries.english_definition: Back part of a ship.
entries.example_in_context: The stern of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR faces the open sea while the bow approaches berth three at Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Popa · parte trasera del buque. Término marítimo estándar.

entries.english_definition: Port worker who physically loads and discharges cargo from vessels.
entries.example_in_context: Luis Mejía, the stevedore in bay 14, loads reefer containers onto the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Estibador · trabajador portuario de carga/descarga. Término estándar en español portuario.

entries.english_definition: Port worker responsible for counting and recording cargo movements per bay.
entries.example_in_context: Yurlenis Palacios is the tally clerk and counts every container loaded onto bay 14 of the MV CARIBBEAN STAR.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Tarjador / Contador de carga · encargado de conteo y registro de carga. 'Tally' anglicismo en jerga portuaria.

entries.english_definition: Operational record of reefer setpoint readings taken at regular intervals.
entries.example_in_context: Pipa instructs Manuel Padilla: Check the temperature log every hour on the MV CARIBBEAN STAR · log setpoint 13.3°C.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Registro/Bitácora de temperatura · documento operativo de control de cadena de frío.

entries.english_definition: Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit · standard 20-foot intermodal container size used in shipping capacity measurement.
entries.example_in_context: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR has capacity for 800 TEU of reefer containers from Puerto Antioquia to Hamburg.
entries.equivalente_espanol: TEU · Unidad Equivalente a Veinte pies. Sigla inglesa estándar en logística (no se traduce).

entries.english_definition: Prepositional phrase of distance using nautical miles (1 nm = 1.852 km).
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas reports: The MV CARIBBEAN STAR is approaching at two nautical miles from Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Dos millas náuticas · frase preposicional de distancia (1 milla náutica = 1.852 km).

_anclaje_matriz.saber_concepto: REVIEW OF PRESENT PROGRESSIVE AND PREPOSITIONAL PHRASES OF GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION AND DISTANCE

entries.english_definition: Very High Frequency · maritime radio band (156-174 MHz) used for ship-to-ship and ship-to-shore voice communication including SMCP.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming contacts Carolina Vargas via VHF channel twelve as the MV CARIBBEAN STAR approaches Puerto Antioquia.
entries.equivalente_espanol: VHF · Frecuencia Muy Alta (radio marítima). Sigla inglesa de uso universal en español técnico.

entries.english_definition: SMCP message marker preceding a safety alert over VHF.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas transmits: Warning. Strong wind from the south · MV CARIBBEAN STAR adjust approach to berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Aviso/Advertencia · marcador SMCP que precede una alerta de seguridad. Anclaje SMCP estándar.

entries.english_definition: Imperative safety directive to put on Personal Protective Equipment.
entries.example_in_context: Hernando Ríos orders: Wear PPE in the reefer yard before approaching the MV CARIBBEAN STAR cargo operations.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Use EPP · imperativo SST de uso obligatorio de Equipo de Protección Personal.

entries.english_definition: Moderate weather conditions favorable to port operations.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming reports: The weather is mild today at Puerto Antioquia · ideal for the MV CARIBBEAN STAR docking.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Clima suave/moderado · condición meteorológica favorable. Patrón descriptivo A2.

entries.english_definition: Present simple temporal Wh-question pattern asking for time/frequency of an action.
entries.example_in_context: Manuel Padilla asks Mariana Restrepo: When do you start the pre-cooling for the MV CARIBBEAN STAR cargo?
entries.equivalente_espanol: ¿Cuándo + verbo? · estructura de pregunta Wh- temporal en presente simple. Patrón A2 estándar.

entries.english_definition: SMCP abbreviation of 'Will Comply' · standard response indicating message understood and instructions will be followed.
entries.example_in_context: Captain Lim Wei-Ming replies: Wilco. Switching to channel twelve · MV CARIBBEAN STAR ready for berthing.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Wilco · 'cumpliré/lo haré' (Will Comply). Anglicismo intraducible en VHF marítima.

entries.english_definition: Low wind condition (Beaufort scale 0-1) favorable to docking maneuvers.
entries.example_in_context: Carolina Vargas reports: The wind is calm at Puerto Antioquia · MV CARIBBEAN STAR proceed to berth three.
entries.equivalente_espanol: Viento en calma · condición de viento muy bajo (Beaufort 0-1). Favorable para maniobras.
